manifestless_correctness.evidence: Launcher tests cover synthetic selection, synthetic mode with null manifest, exact revision readiness, and cold launch; publisher tests cover synthetic publish without a manifest file and current-revision snapshot projection. Both Python suites passed.

projection_integrity.evidence: The initial publisher suite passed 28 tests, but P6 later demonstrated that a generated live control edge could reuse an authored edge ID. This violates role-graph protocol ID uniqueness and requires a publisher fix-forward.

isolation_and_readonly.evidence: Tests reject foreign workspaces before network access, assert source has no process/pane/state mutation or receipt calls, preserve input objects, and prevent mode replacement from targeting agent panes. No manifest or cache file is created.

launcher_lifecycle.evidence: Launcher tests cover exact topology argv matching, same-pane mode replacement, agent-pane exclusion, right-side cold rail, reused-server placement, launch locking, bounded Herdr calls, and concurrent duplicate prevention. Launcher suite passed 30 tests.

backward_compatibility.evidence: Custom precedence and strict malformed/schema/graph/task/layer validation tests passed; Vitest passed 35 tests in 4 files, the Vite production build succeeded, and browser smoke passed with the 11-role scale reported as 1.034.

projection_integrity: P6 finding p6-generated-control-edge-id-collision: generated control edge ID collided with an authored edge ID
backward_compatibility: npm run build and node tests/browser-smoke.mjs: pass

environment_recovery.detail: The worktree had no node_modules. No install was run; package.json and package-lock.json matched the source checkout, whose existing dependency tree was exposed through a temporary symlink for the exact checks and removed by a shell trap.

failures.finding: Generated live control-edge IDs did not allocate around authored edge IDs
failures.expected: Every generated control edge has a stable unique ID while every authored edge and ID remains unchanged
failures.actual: A generated live control edge could reuse the preferred ID of an authored edge, producing duplicate protocol IDs

attribution.reason: The generated edge allocator in adapters/herdr/publisher.py did not include authored edge IDs
